# Build what is left

Only not-implemented tasks remain. One step per ready branch (1.168.0), the first task on it that can start, read from `tasks.md` (`(branch:)`, `(after:)`): `heading` the branch, reason `T9 is the first task that can start.`, label `Run T9:`, command `$crav1-build-walk <slug> T9`, the same command the ready check names. `$crav1-build-tasks` builds one task without the walk; do not add it as a second step. Do not name a ticked or recorded-merged task.
